hooks.command: python3 -c 'import json,sys,os,datetime;p=json.load(sys.stdin);open(os.environ.get("DSH_HOOK_TRACE") or os.path.join(os.environ.get("CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR","."),".dsh","hook-trace.log"),"a").write("%s review SessionStart session=%s source=%s\n" % (datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"), p.get("session_id","?"), p.get("source","?")))'
python3 -c 'import json;print(json.dumps({"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"审核窗口径：每条结论都要带证据（文件:行、命令与输出）；没有证据的写成疑问而不是结论；不要复述代码，只说哪里有问题、为什么、怎么改。"}}))'
python3 -c 'import json;print(json.dumps({"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"审核窗只读：把修改意见写进结论，不要改仓库。这一层与产品自带的只读锁互为双保险。"}}))'

python3 -c 'import json,sys,os,datetime;p=json.load(sys.stdin);t=p.get("tool_input") or {};tgt=t.get("path") or t.get("file_path") or t.get("pattern") or t.get("command") or "";open(os.environ.get("DSH_HOOK_TRACE") or os.path.join(os.environ.get("CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR","."),".dsh","hook-trace.log"),"a").write("%s review read %s %s\n" % (datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"), p.get("tool_name"), str(tgt)[:160]))'
sh -c 'test -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.dsh/hooks/continue" || exit 0; rm -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.dsh/hooks/continue"; echo "还有一条没核：把没核完的那条核掉，或标成未验证。" >&2; exit 2'
